name: Antoine Dubois
title: Principal Data Engineer
summary: Highly accomplished Principal Data Engineer with over a decade of experience designing, building, and optimizing scalable data platforms and pipelines. Proven expertise in big data technologies, cloud architecture, and driving data-driven initiatives to deliver robust analytics and business intelligence solutions. Adept at leading cross-functional teams and implementing best practices in data governance and security.

bullets: Led the design and implementation of a new real-time data streaming platform using Kafka and Spark, processing over 10TB of data daily and reducing data latency by 70%.
Orchestrated the migration of on-premise data warehouses to AWS Redshift, resulting in a 30% cost reduction and a 5x improvement in query performance.
Developed and maintained critical data pipelines in Python and Scala, improving data reliability to 99.9% and supporting advanced analytics initiatives.
Mentored a team of 5 data engineers, fostering best practices in coding, data governance, and scalable architecture.
Designed and built scalable ETL processes for marketing and sales data, integrating over 15 disparate data sources into a central data lake.
Optimized existing SQL queries and data processing jobs, decreasing average execution time by 45% and freeing up computational resources.
Implemented automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts, proactively identifying and resolving data integrity issues.
Contributed to the development of a company-wide data dictionary and governance framework.
Developed and maintained data pipelines using Python scripts for data ingestion, transformation, and loading into PostgreSQL databases.
Collaborated with data scientists to prepare and clean large datasets for machine learning model training, accelerating model deployment cycles by 20%.
Managed database schema changes and performance tuning for OLAP applications.
Automated daily reporting tasks, reducing manual effort by 8 hours per week.

education.degree: M.Sc. in Data Science and Engineering

certifications: Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark
